ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell LocalAccount Manipulation
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may manipulate accounts to maintain access to victim systems.
Account manipulation may consist of any action that preserves adversary access to a compromised account, such as modifying credentials or permission groups
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Disable\\-LocalUser.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Enable\\-LocalUser.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-LocalUser.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-LocalUser.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-LocalUser.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Rename\\-LocalUser.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-LocalUser.*"))
